payload.comment: Ingestion stage is internally consistent. Loaded split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match official PathMNIST splits exactly. n_classes=9 aligns with the 9 listed labels. Provenance is well-documented: archive MD5, per-split index SHA-256 hashes, and a Zenodo data reference are all present. subsampled=false confirms full-dataset use. The test_domain_note correctly flags the known CRC-VAL-HE-7K domain shift (different clinical center), which is a dataset characteristic, not a defect. Run manifest is coherent: seed 72 matches run_id, deterministic_torch=true, and all package versions are recorded. No deterministic findings were raised. Minor observation: llm_model 'qwen3.8' is an atypical model identifier for an Ollama deployment; worth confirming it resolves to the intended base
llm_issues: llm_model 'qwen3.8' is not a standard Qwen release name; verify the Ollama tag resolves to the intended model to avoid silent fallback
test_domain_note documents cross-center domain shift for the test split; ensure downstream evaluation reports this as a known limitation rather than treating it as in-distribution performance
